# Visual asset provenance

Prepared on 2026-10-21 for the QuoteLens interface redesign.

## Current interface font: Source Sans 3

Unmodified Adobe Source Sans 3 upright variable WOFF2, official source commit `87b37a2daaed80fcb8e8ccb0085c4d72ddade12e`.

- Source: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/blob/87b37a2daaed80fcb8e8ccb0085c4d72ddade12e/WOFF2/VF/SourceSans3VF-Upright.ttf.woff2
- Local file: `SourceSans3-Variable.woff2`, 170,188 bytes.
- Complete SIL OFL 1.1 copyright/license: [SourceSans3-OFL.md](SourceSans3-OFL.md).
- Font is locally served; no font service or remote request is required.
- Current bolt line drawing is original project-authored SVG inside the interface. Current social preview is an actual browser screenshot.

## Historical assets below

## Manrope.ttf

Unmodified Manrope variable font downloaded from the official Google Fonts repository:

- Font: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/manrope/Manrope%5Bwght%5D.ttf
- Metadata: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/manrope/METADATA.pb
- License: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/manrope/OFL.txt
- Designer: Mikhail Sharanda / The Manrope Project Authors.
- Weight axis: 200–800. Vietnamese subset included by the upstream font.
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; the complete upstream notice is included as `OFL.txt`.
- SHA-256: `3ae11c49db0455a3cc33e37d380f20fdb8c7f8b41dc07625c177e3d87a9d6ae6`.

The filename has been shortened for local hosting; the font binary is unchanged. The upstream directory, metadata and license were checked using the GitHub connector before downloading the official binary. No font service or third-party request is necessary at runtime.

## glass-study.png

An original AI-generated decorative sculpture produced with the built-in image generation tool on 2026-10-21. It does not depict product functionality or a customer result. No artwork from the user's Lifemed reference was copied or supplied as an edit target. The reference informed broad art direction only: white space, restrained type and translucent glass.

- File: 1254 × 1254 PNG, 32-bit RGBA with transparent alpha.
- Bytes: 1,783,450.
- SHA-256: `8016b9e8be530f3ef74e041a13ea77833bc8a4506920cb94602be14a516d2361`.
- Visual inspection: overlapping folded glass sheets, lavender/cobalt/rose refraction; no logos, text or UI. The background alpha was checked separately.

### Final generation prompt

> Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium website hero sculpture, isolated on genuine transparent alpha, no opaque backdrop. Create a photorealistic optical glass sculpture for a refined quote-comparison product: three broad translucent folded glass sheets overlap in a restrained sculptural stack, like gently bowed rectangular pages with softly rounded corners and deep bevels. Not a literal paper document and no writing. Three-quarter studio view, diagonally balanced, occupies about 80% of square frame, fully visible silhouette with breathing room. Truly transparent colorless glass body with sophisticated lilac, cobalt blue and faint rose iridescent refraction only along the folds and edges. Fluid thick smooth glass, sharp caustic detail, soft specular highlights, subtle luminous reflected blue near base. Editorial high-end product CGI, physical ray tracing, extremely polished and architectural. Strong clear sculptural volume; predominantly pale white-lavender glass, not a solid purple object. Lighting broad white studio softboxes, crisp beautiful highlights and believable optical refraction. Constraints: original form, no logos, no text, no UI, no watermark, no icons, no stock cartoon, no pedestal, no dark background, no grain, no glitter, no surrounding objects, no copied artwork. This must be suitable for compositing on a clean white website.

## Social preview — 21 October 2026

`social-preview.jpg` was replaced for the Cosmos redesign on 21 October 2026. It is an unaltered 1280×720 CUA-controlled browser capture of the working local preview of the source being released. It shows a first-visit interface with empty local files or an explicitly fictional starting puzzle. It is not a generated mockup or evidence of customer use. The earlier glass-image sections above describe retained historical assets; the current app does not load the glass hero or Three.js. Retained third-party assets keep their separate license notices.

## Reviewer case-study assets — 21 October 2026

`review-record.png` is a fresh unaltered browser capture of the current local app with the previously recorded fictional EUR 60.95 workspace at revision 8. `reviewer-offers.csv` and `reviewed-receipt.json` are exact copies of the synthetic input and actual exported revision 7 receipt in `docs/evidence/cosmos-functional-*`. They contain no customer records. The case study labels their role and review date explicitly; the screenshot is evidence of product state, not artwork from a reference gallery.
